notes: Short, self-contained and stable: fixes the notice period owed on dismissal and on resignation by reference to the employee's seniority and whether the employee is monthly-paid or paid otherwise, requires the notice in writing, and makes payment in lieu of notice compulsory where the employer dispenses with the notice period. Because it has only one amendment (2014), the consolidated text can be reconstructed from the original plus one amending Act, which is the closest thing to an authoritative consolidation available for free in Israel.
